sections.html: Aplocheilichthys normani (= Poropanchax normani) is a classic among the fish species that Takashi Amano preferred to use for his nature aquarium setups.

A single specimen of this lampeye is a rather drab creature, but a larger school in a tank with dimmed light is like magic! The blue eyes drift like small fireflies through the underwater world.

Both wild-caught fish from Guinea and bred fish from Indonesia are available. Keeping these fish is very easy, but avoid the mistake of keeping too few specimens. A school of 20-30 animals is perfect.
